events.verdict: Iguodala (GSW) makes clean contact with the ball while defending Finney-Smith's (DAL) shot attempt.
Durant (GSW) sets the screen on Jordan (DAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Barnes (DAL) and Durant (GSW) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Green (GSW) sets the screen on Finney-Smith (DAL) and does not deliver contact.
Durant (GSW) makes incidental contact with Barnes (DAL) during his drive.
Barnes (DAL) makes contact with the ball, any additional contact to Durant (GSW) is deemed incidental.
Barnes (DAL) maintains a legal guarding position on Durant's (GSW) driving shot attempt.
Jordan (DAL) and Iguodala (GSW) briefly engage and separate off ball.
Curry (GSW) makes contact with Jordan's (DAL) head during his shot attempt.
Green (GSW) sets the screen on Barnes (DAL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
[Observable in enhanced video] Durant (GSW) slides his pivot foot after gathering his dribble.
Green (GSW) sets the pick on Barnes (DAL) and does not deliver contact.
Jordan (DAL) legally contests Durant's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Looney (GSW) makes incidental contact with Brunson (DAL) that does not affect his SQBR during his drive.
Matthews (DAL) and Iguodala (GSW) make incidental leg to leg contact as they move to the same spot.
Green (GSW) and Barnes (DAL) briefly engage and separate during the rebound.
Finney-Smith (DAL) commits a take foul on Looney (GSW).
